title: THE PIMPLE POPPING MACHINE
tickerText: *** EEEEEEEEWWWW !!! ****** WELCOME TO THE PIMPLE POPPING MACHINE! THE INTERNET'S MOST GLORIOUSLY GROSS COLLECTION OF POPS, SQUEEZES, SPLATS AND SKIN-CLEARING SATISFACTION! STEP RIGHT UP, BRACE YOURSELF AND GET READY FOR THE VIDEOS YOU JUST CAN'T LOOK AWAY FROM! WE'RE TALKING MONSTER BLACKHEADS, STUBBORN WHITEHEADS, EPIC EXTRACTIONS AND THOSE BEAUTIFULLY DISGUSTING MOMENTS THAT MAKE YOU SHOUT "OH, THAT'S HORRIBLE" WHILE WATCHING IT AGAIN! THIS IS YOUR ONE-STOP SHOP FOR THE BEST OF THE WORST, WHERE EVERY SPIN DELIVERS ANOTHER DOSE OF EYE-WATERING, JAW-DROPPING, STRANGELY RELAXING GROSSNESS! LOVE A SLOW BUILD-UP? WE'VE GOT IT! CRAVE THAT BIG, SATISFYING RELEASE? OH, WE'VE DEFINITELY GOT THAT! FROM TINY LITTLE POPS TO THE SORT OF EXTRACTIONS THAT DESERVE THEIR OWN DRAMATIC SOUNDTRACK, IT'S ALL HERE IN ONE RIDICULOUSLY ADDICTIVE MACHINE. NO JUDGEMENT, NO SHAME, JUST PURE POPPING PLEASURE! PULL THE LEVER, DISCOVER YOUR NEXT FAVOURITE VIDEO AND SEE HOW LONG YOU CAN LAST WITHOUT SAYING "EEEEWWWWW!" THEN IMMEDIATELY GOING BACK FOR MORE! THE PIMPLE POPPING MACHINE: BIG POPS, BIGGER REACTIONS, MAXIMUM SATISFACTION! WARNING: MAY CAUSE SUDDEN GASPS, UNCONTROLLABLE GRINNING AND THE IRRESISTIBLE URGE TO WATCH JUST ONE MORE!
